no_races: Here you will see the runs records
no_templates_found:
Create or add a template from the default list.
Active templates are used by the program to determine the start, split, and finish of runs.
sequential_mode_tooltip:
If the mode is enabled, missions within groups
must be completed strictly in sequence.
exclude_time_between_groups_tooltip:
If disabled, the time between groups
(loading between missions) is included in the total time.
If enabled, the timer is frozen during intervals,
recording only the net time spent on missions.
input_codes_help:
You can enter multiple codes in a single field
separated by {'“||”'} to search for alternative matches.
Use “=>” to search for two codes in sequence:
the second code will only be searched after the first one is found.
template_already_exists: template with that name already exists
enter_mission_code_all_groups:
enter the mission code for all groups,
or keep only one group
confirm_save: How would you like to save the template?
enable_desc: Time recording is independent of the overlay.
overlay_browser: Show the overlay content at the local address
overlay_browser_desc: The source will work even with the overlay turned off.
number_of_splits_desc: If you set 0, all splits will be showed.
time_gold: Highlight the difference in gold for the best
sum_of_best_desc: Show the sum of the best segments
predicting_timer: Show the predicted time of the race: Disruption level cap
predicting_timer_desc:
It is calculated using the following formula:
(total time spent on completed rounds × 45 ÷ number of completed rounds)
+ time until the first round
fake_timer_desc: It's fake because it doesn't affect the time recording.
run_aborted: Show the number of canceled or failed missions
sum_of_the_last_desc: Show the total of the last runs
